body:
**Filing gate ③**, a follow-up owed by landing work. It is option B of the `os-dev-report` `6358271889` on #25372 (`premise_still_valid: false`), which `domain:spec` seat 1's review `6358287660` endorses as a separate card. Filed by the triage seat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) as part of the #25372 re-scope. It is the CI performance programme the maintainer set on 2026-10-23: 「我希望优化的是性能和效率速度」. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:devx` execution seat, in the same lane as #25376 (shard count). It is one os-dev and one PR.

## One-sentence problem

The 24.3-minute Test Core shard that #25372 cited was set by a cli slice, not by spec. The partition predicted 735 s for it, CI measured 1132 s (×1.54), and the dataset the prediction comes from is dated 2026-10-13.

## Evidence (the dev's readings on `origin/main` `c898bd8`; the triage seat did not re-measure)

- **Run 39893808670, `Test Core (3/6)`:** the tests step ran from 03:16:20 to 03:40:37 (24.3 min). The cli slice leg took 18m52.554s (vitest Duration 1129.45 s). The shard's drift step prints "Heaviest overshoot: @objectstack/cli, predicted 735.3s, measured 1132.4s". Spec is not among that shard's overshoots.
- **Merge-group run 39894014103 aggregate:** cli 2138.29 s across its 3 slices.
- **`scripts/test-shard-timings.json`:** last refreshed by #23141 on 2026-10-13. The weekly `shard-timings-refresh.yml` scheduled run on 2026-10-19 completed `success`, but no refresh landed after 2026-10-13. The dev reads why: a refresh that opened no PR, or a PR that never merged.
- **Pin 3c (`sliceCountProblems` in `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs`):** it judges `{cli: 3}` with no problems on the committed dataset. A recount has to pass it on the refreshed dataset.

## Ask

1. Land a refreshed `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` through the repo's own refresh lane (`shard-timings-refresh.yml`, from the hourly `schedule` run of `ci.yml`, never a push run, per the workflow's header and #16467). Not by hand.
2. Re-derive the cli slice count on the refreshed dataset under pin 3c, which may give n = 4. Change `FILE_SHARDED_PACKAGES` only if the pin accepts the new count.
3. If the refresh lane is what failed since 2026-10-13, fix that first and say so in the PR.

`.github/workflows/**` is Tier H. If the fix needs a workflow change, the dev stops and reports it.

## Done when

- The dataset is no more than 7 days old at merge.
- The cli slice count is the one pin 3c accepts on that dataset.
- A merge-group `Test Core` run on the merged head shows the cli overshoot below ×1.2. The PR quotes the drift line.

**Size:** S–M.

## Dedupe

Method: open objectstack-ai/objectstack issues labelled `area:devpath`, and the last 100 PRs, matched on `shard`, `timing` and `slice`. Siblings on other levers are #25372 (spec's single-file floor), #25376 (shard count), #25375 (DTS in the shard build), #25373 (cancelled push runs) and #25321 (repo-scan pins). None carries the cli drift or the stale dataset. **New.**
